title: Concept: Compose service shares the host PID namespace — review required
description: In compose, a service shares the host PID namespace. Process isolation is one of the boundaries a container is expected to provide, and removing it exposes process lists and signal delivery across the node. Command lines frequently carry credentials, so the exposure is not limited to availability.
applicability: compose Compose deployments on shared hosts.
risk: Cross-container process visibility and signalling; MEDIUM severity.
